name: hook-missing
description: Same single-tool shape as happy.json, but meant to be run with AGY_FAKE_SKIP_HOOKS=1 (README.md) so <ws>/.agents/hooks.json is never loaded even though --add-dir is present — reproduces 'hooks.json failed to load' for PR3's runtime gate-confirmation watchdog (I4), without needing a genuinely broken hooks.json on disk.
